人情世故？

李青山忍不住想要骂娘，你个老娘们刚刚跟着赵强他们一起诬陷老子，别当老子眼瞎没看见。

“婶子，我李青山还是个单身汉，没媳妇呢！”

“你家不是有两个儿媳妇吗？”

“今天晚上分我一个，让我也过一过当男人的瘾，你看行不行？”

李青山盯着麻子婶道。

“李青山，你个二流子胡诌什么呢？我家儿媳妇怎么能陪你睡觉？”

麻子婶顿时气急败坏道。

“我的山鸡，凭什么给你啊！”

“让开！”

李青山脸上满是不爽，拎着野物便朝着家中赶去。

村民们望着李青山和大壮等人离去的背影，眼神中满是羡慕和嫉妒之色，怎么自己就没这么好的运气呢？

“偷的，肯定是偷的！”

“别看这小子现在蹦跶的欢，等人家猎物带着政府的人上门了，说不定还要把这小子拉去枪毙呢！”

赵强从地上爬起来，摸着疼痛的身子开口道。

“嗯，我也觉得是偷的！”赵有田这位李老屯的死对头，也肯定道。

“政府的人赶紧来才好，赶紧把这个二流子抓去毙了，竟然还想让我家儿媳妇陪他睡觉？”

“做梦去吧！”

麻子婶在后面也跟着骂道。

“这次运气好，打了些猎物罢了，我还不信，他能次次都打这么多。”

“年轻人啊，真是沉不住气。”

赵有田开口讽刺道。

老李家！

现在已经到了晚饭时间，还是院子里的那一张桌子，最上面放着玉米面饼，一碟炒菜，半颗咸鸭蛋……！

下面，则是红薯粥，咸菜……！

李老屯伸出筷子，先是挖了一些咸鸭蛋，放在大孙子李青书的碗里，然后又用筷子挑了一些放在自己碗里，舔了舔筷子，吧唧吧唧嘴，脸上满是享受之色。

家中老二，老三，以及各自的婆娘，孙媳妇柳桂香，只能端着手中的红薯粥，羡慕的望着坐在椅子上的李老屯等人。

老二这一房倒还好，虽然吃不上咸鸭蛋和炒菜，却也能吃上一口玉米饼子，三房就悲惨了，只能喝一喝红薯粥，一天下来放屁不断。

“三叔，青山已经上山两三天了吧？”饭桌上，李青书突然开口问道。

“算上今天，三天了！”李三奎憨厚的点了点头道。

“三叔，老林子里面危险重重，咱们说句不好听的，万一青山没能从老林子里面走出来，你得去找一趟李虎，告诉李虎那新房子不是李青山的，是爷爷要留给我的。”

“不能因为李青山留下来的欠条，找到我们身上。”

李青书开口道。

新建的房子，那可是爷爷要留给自己的，哪能因为李青山那小子一句话，就抵给李虎呢？

“青书说得对！”

“老三，你听到没有？”

李三奎本来想开口反驳，却不曾想李老屯率先开口，盯着李三奎给这件事情定了调子道。

“知道了，爹！”

李三奎无奈，只得点头应下。

“李青书，青山肯定能安全回来的。”坐在桌子最尾端的柳桂香咬牙反驳道。

“嫂子，李青山能不能回来，你说了也不算！”

“但是，老林子这些年吃了不少人进去，是大家都心知肚明的。”

“李青山一个什么都不懂的毛头小子，就这么冒冒失失的进了老林子，胆子真是大，能出来才怪了。”

李青山不爽的看着柳桂香道。

“老林子吃人和青山有什么关系？”

“这些年，进了老林子出来的猎户多了去了，我相信青山肯定能回来，而且一定能打到猎物。”

柳桂香开口道。

“哈哈……！”

柳桂香话音落下，李青书便忍不住笑出声来，开口讽刺道：“他一个第一次上山的新人，能安全回来就不错了，还想着能将打到猎物，真是痴心妄想！”

“桂香，李青山那个二流子，平日里就不务正业，附近村子里可都是出了名的，和青有，青余差远了，要是当初也能够一起去赵木匠那些学一门手艺，再过两年就能和青有青余一起出师了！”

“兄弟三人，开一个作坊，养家糊口是没问题的。”

“年轻人，不知道脚踏实地，还想着学人去上山打猎，这次能回来就够呛，至于什么能打到猎物，就别想了，还浪费了咱们家不少玉米面。”

“要我看，就算这小子回来后，也不能让他上桌吃饭！”

“以后啊，蹲在桌子尾那里，等到咱们什么时候吃完了，才能允许他吃，也让他长一长教训，做人还是要脚踏实地的，和我家青有，青余一样。”

就在这时。

Sophisticated people?

Li Qingshan couldn't help but want to scold his mother, you old woman just followed Zhao Qiang and others to frame me, don't pretend that I am blind and didn't see it.

"Auntie, I, Li Qingshan, am still a single man without a wife!"

"Don't you have two daughters-in-law at home?"

"Let me have one of you tonight so that I can experience the addiction of being a man. Do you think that's okay?"

Li Qingshan stared at Aunt Mazi and said.

"Li Qingshan, what are you talking about, you idiot? How can my daughter-in-law sleep with you?"

Aunt Mazi suddenly became furious.

"Why should I give my pheasant to you?"

"Get out of the way!"

Li Qingshan's face was full of displeasure, and he rushed home with the wild animals in hand.

The villagers looked at the departing figures of Li Qingshan, Da Zhuang and others, their eyes filled with envy and jealousy. Why were they not so lucky?

"It's stolen, it must be stolen!"

"Don't look at how happy this kid is now. When someone else's prey comes to the door with government officials, they might drag this kid to be shot!"

Zhao Qiang got up from the ground, touched his painful body and said.

"Well, I think it was stolen too!" Zhao Youtian, Li Laotun's sworn enemy, also confirmed.

“It’s best for the government people to come quickly and arrest this second-rate guy and kill him. He actually wants my daughter-in-law to sleep with him?”

"Go ahead and dream!"

Aunt Mazi also cursed behind her.

"I was lucky this time. I just caught some prey. I still don't believe that he can kill so many times."

"Young man, you really can't hold your breath."

Zhao Youtian said sarcastically.

Lao Li's house!

It's dinner time now, and it's still the same table in the yard, with cornmeal pancakes on top, a plate of stir-fried vegetables, and half a salted duck egg...!

Below, there are sweet potato porridge and pickles...!

Li Laotun stretched out his chopsticks, first dug out some salted duck eggs, and put them in the bowl of his eldest grandson Li Qingshu. Then he picked some with chopsticks and put them in his own bowl. He licked the chopsticks and smacked his lips, with a look of enjoyment on his face.

The second and third eldest children in the family, as well as their respective mothers-in-law and granddaughter-in-law Liu Guixiang, could only hold the sweet potato porridge in their hands and look enviously at Li Laotun and others sitting on the chairs.

The second room was fine. Although they couldn't eat salted duck eggs and stir-fried vegetables, they could still eat a bite of corn pancakes. The third room was miserable. They could only drink sweet potato porridge and fart constantly throughout the day.

"Third uncle, have you been up the mountain for two or three days?" Li Qingshu suddenly asked at the dinner table.

"Including today, it's been three days!" Li Sankui nodded honestly.

"Third uncle, there are many dangers in the old forest. Let's put it bluntly. If Qingshan fails to come out of the old forest, you have to go find Li Hu and tell Li Hu that the new house does not belong to Li Qingshan, but is left to me by grandpa."

"The IOU left by Li Qingshan cannot be found on us."

Li Qingshu said.

The newly built house was what grandpa wanted to leave to him. How could he give it to Li Hu just because of a word from that boy Li Qingshan?

"Qingshu is right!"

"Third brother, did you hear that?"

Li Sankui originally wanted to retort, but he never thought that Li Laotun would speak first and stared at Li Sankui to set the tone for the matter.

"I got it, Dad!"

Li Sankui had no choice but to nod in agreement.

"Li Qingshu, Qingshan will definitely come back safely." Liu Guixiang, who was sitting at the end of the table, gritted her teeth and retorted.

"Sister-in-law, it doesn't matter whether Li Qingshan can come back or not!"

"But Lao Linzi has eaten a lot of people over the years, and everyone knows it."

"Li Qingshan is a young boy who doesn't know anything. He just entered the old forest so recklessly. He is so courageous. It's strange that he came out."

Li Qingshan looked at Liu Guixiang unhappily and said.

"What does the old forest have to do with cannibalism of people and green mountains?"

"In recent years, many hunters have entered the old forest and come out. I believe Qingshan will definitely come back and he will definitely be able to catch prey."

Liu Guixiang said.

"Haha...!"

After Liu Guixiang finished speaking, Li Qingshu couldn't help laughing, and said sarcastically: "He is a newcomer going up the mountain for the first time. It would be great if he can come back safely. He still thinks that he can catch prey. What a wishful thinking!"

"Guixiang, that second-rate guy Li Qingshan usually doesn't do his job properly. He is famous in the nearby villages. He is far different from Qingyou and Qingyu. If we could go to Zhao Carpenter's to learn a craft together, in two years we can start training together with Qingyou and Qingyu!"

"It's no problem for three brothers to open a workshop and support their families."

"Young people don't know how to keep their feet on the ground. They still want to imitate others and go hunting in the mountains. It's hard to come back this time. As for how to catch prey, don't even think about it. It also wastes a lot of cornmeal in our family."

"Let me see, even if this kid comes back, we can't let him eat on the table!"

"From now on, squat at the end of the table and wait until we finish eating before allowing him to eat. It will also teach him a lesson that a person should be down-to-earth, just like my Qingyou and Qingyu."

Just then.
